    Periodic components are connected stable translation quivers #

    Proof of Proposition 5.3, reduction to components: on a finite translation quiver, a periodic component K is closed under τ^{±1} and every vertex of K is the translate of a vertex of K, so the full translation subquiver on K is stable; it is connected by arrows and translation edges.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
